Jenna (People Ops): Hi all :wave: Announcing a 6-month pilot for a phased return-from-parental-leave program. The goal is to give new parents a structured, manager-approved option to ramp back to full-time over up to 8 weeks with preserved benefits. Quick notes: 1) Eligibility: employees returning from primary parental leave (birth, adoption, foster placement) between May 1–Nov 1, 2026. 2) Options: a) 8-week phased schedule (examples below), b) 4-week intensive ramp. 3) Pay/benefits: payroll remains at full-time base pay; hours are scheduled as reduced FTE for the phase; K benefits & accruals continue. 4) Manager approval + People Ops sign-off required. 5) Sign-up form: https://intranet.redwood/parental-phased-pilot (deadline May 15) Please review and share questions — we'll run an info session next Wed 10:30am PT.

Chris (Eng Manager): Thanks Jenna. Two quick Qs: 1) Do offshore teammates (EMEA/APAC) qualify if their leave overlaps the window? 2) Any guidance for on-call rotations while on a phased schedule? :thinking_face:

Jenna (People Ops): Great Qs. Eligibility is global — managers should coordinate start dates to align with local labor rules; People Ops will do a compliance check for non-US hires. For on-call: phased participants should be temporarily exempt from primary on-call duties for the first 4 weeks unless they opt in and both manager + participant confirm coverage. We'll add a short template for manager consent.

Maria L (People Ops): FYI for payroll admins: payroll will continue to pay at base salary; HRIS will set a "phased-FTE" flag so benefits deductions stay the same. Managers: please submit the "Phased Return Plan" form and cc payroll at payroll@redwood.com.

people-ops-bot: Reminder set: Info session "Phased Return Pilot Q&A" Wed 10:30am PT — calendar invites sent to sign-ups. :bell:

Priya K: Quick clarifying question — does this include adoptive parents who were on a 12-week leave? I'm returning in July and wondering which option to pick.

Alex (People Ops): Hi Priya — yes, adoptive and foster parents are included. Example schedule we recommend (feel free to customize with your manager):

```
Week 1-2: 60% time (3 days on, 2 days off) — core meetings only
Week 3-4: 80% time (4 days on, 1 day off) — expand recurring meetings
Week 5-8: 100% time or 90% transitional if needed
```

Managers: please treat these as guidelines — flexibility is the point. We'll review utilization after the pilot and share learnings. If you want to opt in or have edge cases (medical leave overlap, visa constraints), DM People Ops or email phased-pilot@redwood.com. :heart:

Chris (Eng Manager): Appreciated. We'll discuss on Monday's 1:1s and I may reach out with a couple of edge-case scenarios. :thumbsup:

Jenna (People Ops): Thanks everyone. We'll post the full FAQ and the manager consent template later today. If you want early access to the template, ping me directly. :seedling:
